title: Verify diagnostic capture recipes in an isolated session
changes: Document end-to-end audio, code, gameplay and graphics recipe execution in an isolated EUR interpreter session.
validation: Each of four recipes produced one report with the expected kind; audio, code and gameplay each advanced one frame, graphics advanced none, and explicit second resumes neither duplicated reports nor changed state. Protected inputs stayed unchanged and the GUI closed normally. A stripped copy of the previously built runtime was used.
limitations: This covers one isolated EUR interpreter session and checks report production, not capture fidelity, physical audio, native Windows, physical controls or other scenes. Private session copies remain as a named current proof pending replacement.
